'''SecOps Four''' was a member of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and personal bodyguard to [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|Spymaster]] [[Koth Melan]]. 

==History==
One time, he worked alongside two other bodyguards, known as [[SecOps Five]] and [[SecOps Seven]] when Melan was returning to [[Safehouse Besh]]. When Seven reported that he found something on the hatch, Four was sent to assist. It turned out that it was a [[Flexiplast]] flier from [[Krazy Khzam's Repulsor Lot|local repulsor lot]]. After being scanned for poisons, devices, or other dangerous elements, he entered to inspect the safehouse, and stoked up the burner on the fireside when Melan arrived.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Safehouse Besh (short story)|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

In 3 ABY, SecOps Four was present in the [[Bothan safehouse]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] with Koth Melan and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as the [[Death Star II plans]], contained in a stolen supercomputer, were decrypted. The safehouse was attacked by a team of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who killed Melan and captured Skywalker.

SecOps Four's leg was wounded by a blaster bolt during the attack, but he was able to escape with the coveted plans by using a piece of plastic pipe as a makeshift cane. While he made his way through [[Tal'cara]]'s industrial sector on foot, intending to hobble to the spynet's hidden ship in a concealed hangar bay, SecOps Four was waylaid by a group of Bothan Spynet members who were of a competing faction. These Bothans, led by [[Vord'lya]] and loyal to [[Borsk Fey'lya]], stunned SecOps Four and stole the case containing the Death Star II plans. They delivered the plans to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] themselves, allowing [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s faction to take the credit.
